before:
CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_CLOSE'
      EXPORTING
        jobname = lv_jobname
        jobcount = lv_jobcount
        strtimmed = 'X'
after:
{{#doctor_event}}
    DATA lv_watchname TYPE tbtcjob-jobname.
    DATA lv_watchcount TYPE tbtcjob-jobcount.
    DATA lv_eventparm TYPE c LENGTH 64.
    lv_watchname = 'L3_{{set_upper}}_END'.
    lv_eventparm(32) = lv_jobname.
    lv_eventparm+32(8) = lv_jobcount.
    CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_OPEN' EXPORTING jobname = lv_watchname
      IMPORTING jobcount = lv_watchcount EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_SUBMIT' EXPORTING jobname = lv_watchname jobcount = lv_watchcount
        report = '{{autodoctor.doctor_report_upper}}' authcknam = sy-uname EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_CLOSE' EXPORTING jobname = lv_watchname jobcount = lv_watchcount
          event_id = 'SAP_END_OF_JOB' event_param = lv_eventparm EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
{{/doctor_event}}
    CALL FUNCTION 'JOB_CLOSE'
      EXPORTING
        jobname = lv_jobname
        jobcount = lv_jobcount
        strtimmed = 'X'

before:
ELSEIF lv_finished = 'X' OR lv_aborted = 'X'.
          lv_reason = 'JOB-ENDED'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
after:
ELSEIF lv_finished = 'X' OR lv_aborted = 'X'.
          lv_reason = 'JOB-ENDED'.
{{#autodoctor}}
        ELSEIF lv_running = 'X' AND ls_pile-status = 'RUNNING' AND ls_pile-started <= lv_stale.
          lv_reason = 'JOB-SILENT'.
{{/autodoctor}}
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

before:
APPEND LINES OF lt_purged TO rt_report.
  ENDMETHOD.
